jsonld_raw.name: ENERGETICALLY NEW YORK EDP 3.4 FL. OZ.
jsonld_raw.description:
ENERGETICALLY NEW YORK EDP 3.4 FL. OZ. Capture the magnetic energy of New York: rhythm, creativity, and constant movement. It evokes the city's intensity and the contrast between the urban pulse and a weekend getaway, when the air shifts and everything feels lighter. Cardamom adds a spicy, vibrant freshness balanced by the luminous elegance of jasmine. Sandalwood introduces an enveloping, structured warmth, creating a fragrance with character that is both modern and sophisticated.

A collection created by Ms. Jo Malone CBE, founder of Jo Loves.

Woody spicy | Magnetic, vibrant, and sophisticated
